subject: Sponsor package request for LaunchHub cohort — rate-card exception?
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@launchhub.co>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Sponsor pricing for LaunchHub May cohort

Hi Karthik and Ben,

LaunchHub runs a five-week startup cohort and we're lining up sponsors for the May class (starts June 7). We typically offer a sponsorship benefit that gives each accepted startup a set of platform credits and discounted pricing for the first three months.

This year we have 25 startups and are asking Redwood to be the exclusive inference sponsor. High-level ask: 50% credits (applied as a promotional credit pool) for six months, plus a 20% discount on committed usage for startups that convert to paid accounts.

To help you evaluate: most early teams will consume between 50k–250k tokens/month during prototype phases; a handful (3–4) could spike to ~1M token/mo during demos. We can provide a short list of the startups and a shared doc with usage estimates (attached).

Can you share what exceptions you can approve for program partners? If there are tiering or packaging constraints, we can adapt — we care most about predictable sponsor credits and a simple onboarding flow for the founders.

Attached: LaunchHub_Sponsorship_Pack.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Emma Li
Head of Partnerships, LaunchHub
emma@launchhub.co

--
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma@launchhub.co>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-14T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Sponsor pricing for LaunchHub May cohort

Hi Emma — thanks for the note and the pack. This is the sort of partner program we prioritize. A few clarifying questions to scope the ask and surface approval needs: 

- Do the startups pay anything during the sponsor credits period or is the sponsor covering all consumption?
- Of the 25 startups, how many are pre-revenue vs paying customers of LaunchHub partners (approx %)?
- Can you confirm whether the 50% is intended as a credit pool (one pool applied at billing) or as an across-the-board SKUs discount on token billing?
- Any regulatory/data residency constraints we should be aware of for any founders in EU/APAC?

For speed, I attached our sponsor-rate-template.xlsx — please fill in expected per-team monthly token usage and billing contact, that helps our finance + CS approval.

If we move forward, approvals will be needed from sales leadership for a promotional credits carveout and from finance for an accounting treatment (credits vs discount). Ben/Lauren — can you flag any immediate red flags?

Best,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sponsor-rate-template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

--
From: Emma Li <emma@launchhub.co>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Alvarez <sam@launchhub.co>
Date: 2027-05-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Sponsor pricing for LaunchHub May cohort

Hi Karthik — thanks. Quick answers inline: 

- Sponsor covers the credits for the first three months entirely; after that startups are expected to convert to paying accounts (we can coordinate billing introductions).
- Rough split: ~60% pre-revenue, 40% have early ARR or paying pilots.
- Intended flow is a promotional credit pool tied to each startup account created during onboarding (not a global discount applied to all LaunchHub customers).
- All startups in this cohort are US-based, no EU/APAC residency issues.

I've attached our filled usage estimates CSV. Sam is copied to coordinate logistics and the onboarding list.

Attachment: usage-estimates.csv (text/csv)

Look forward to next steps,
Emma

--
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-16T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: LaunchHub sponsor ask — recommended commercial structure

Karthik / Lauren — reviewed LaunchHub pack and usage estimates. High-level recommendation: we can support a sponsor program but should constrain exposure. Proposed commercial: 

- Sponsor package: promotional credits equivalent to 40% of our standard onboarding allotment for each of up to 20 startups (not 25).
- Duration: 3 months of credited consumption; additional 3 months can be offered at a 25% discount if they convert to paid plans.
- Finance preference: treat as a promotional credit (contra-revenue) to avoid discounting list price. Need approval from Finance for the contra-revenue bucket and for any GAAP implications.

I've run a quick P&L sensitivity and attached pricing-impact-estimate.pdf. Main risk is three or four heavy users that drive token consumption — we should require a modest cap per-account for the promo or an overage rate to protect unit economics.

If we approve, we should ask LaunchHub to commit to a list of startups up front and a single billing contact. Also recommend a simple onboarding playbook to avoid manual work for CS.

Ben
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing-impact-estimate.pdf (application/pdf)

--
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma@launchhub.co>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-18T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Sponsor pricing for LaunchHub May cohort

Hi Emma — appreciate the quick turnaround. Based on internal review, Redwood can offer a sponsor package with the following terms: 

1) Sponsor package: promotional credit equal to 40% of our standard onboarding allotment per startup for up to 20 startups from the May cohort.
2) Duration: credits apply for the first 3 months after each startup account is created.
3) Conversion benefit: if a startup converts to a paid account within 90 days, we will extend a 25% committed-usage discount for the next 3 months (applies only to verified conversions).
4) Per-account cap: promotional credits capped at the equivalent of 750k tokens per startup over the 3 months; overages billed at standard rates.
5) Implementation: LaunchHub to provide a verified list of startups and a single billing contact. Redwood will create promotional credit codes and provide an onboarding playbook for founders.

If that works, I can route a DocuSign SOW for a partner sponsorship agreement and a short addendum for Finance to treat credits as contra-revenue. I'll include the SOW link and billing instructions in the DocuSign packet.

DocuSign (proposal): https://app.docusign.com/pack/DocuSign_Link_LaunchHub_Proposal_4729
Shared onboarding sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1A2b3LaunchHubShared

Please confirm the 20 startups and the billing contact and we'll kick off the SOW.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: LaunchHub_Sponsorship_Pack.pdf (application/pdf)

--
